en:
No, the mastermind can't be a 17th person.
That contradicts what <CLT=cltSTRONG>Motherkuma<CLT=cltNORMAL> said.

The one you're all looking for comes to
this room quite often.

It implies that the mastermind wasn't
in the hidden room the whole time.

They must have been coming and going
between the room and the academy, right?

Would someone who has to stay completely
hidden really risk that?

Right. If they were trying to hide,
they woulda just stayed put.
I see! That's some impressive logic!
Don't agree with him!

And during the investigation, I found a
<CLT=cltSTRONG>classroom that makes Flashback Lights<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
A classroom that makes Flashback Lights?

Ah, I'll explain the details later...
But there was something interesting...

<CLT=cltMIND>Right at that moment, the
classroom door suddenly burst open.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*woosh!*
There you are, Shuichi!
H-Himiko!?

<CLT=cltMIND>...Huh? The classroom changed
back to normal?

When the door is opened, the classroom
reverts to its <CLT=cltSTRONG>original state<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Clearly, the room is hiding something.
Isn't it obvious?

The mastermind didn't want anyone to see them
making Flashback Lights...

But why create such a classroom at all?
If the mastermind were a 17th person...

...they could have their own completely
separate room to make Flashback Lights.
Indeed... That would be much safer.

Knowing this, we can make a few assumptions
about the mastermind's identity.
However, the implications...aren't good.
Wh-What an ominous way to say it...

But there's nothing to worry about!
We got this far because we're friends!

We're in this together, no matter what!
There's nothing to fear!
Y-Yeah! She's right!
<CLT=cltMIND>The mastermind's identity...

<CLT=cltMIND>Considering the facts we have,
my detective work points to...
Kaede Akamatsu

<CLT=cltMIND>No...
There's no hard evidence of that.

Don't be all ominous and then 
stop talking! We can face the truth!

<CLT=cltMIND>I have to face the truth...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Kaede Akamatsu's twin sister

<CLT=cltMIND>No...there's no real proof she
has a twin sister in the first place.

We're all friends! We've overcome many hardships
to get this far. So don't hesitate to tell us!

<CLT=cltMIND>I have to face the truth...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
A participant of the killing game
The 17th person

<CLT=cltMIND>No, the evidence we've gathered so
far suggests there is no 17th person...

It's okay, Shuichi! We're all friends!
So just tell us what's on your mind!

<CLT=cltMIND>No...
I have to face the truth...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

...Who is it?
We came this far, so you should say it.

<CLT=cltMIND>No...
I have to face the truth...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
<CLT=cltMIND>The identity of the mastermind is...

The mastermind is most likely...<CLT=cltSTRONG>one of the
participants of this killing game<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
O-One of the...participants!?

One of the 16 people who were forced
to play this game. One of us.
Wh-What...did you say?

The classroom that makes Flashback Lights
and the hidden room being visited often...

It all suggests that the mastermind is someone
<CLT=cltSTRONG>we'd see every day at the academy<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Someone we'd see every day...
Like one of the 16 students?

Th-That's crazy! There's no way one
of us is the mastermind!

Because...we're all friends!
We swore to fight together!

Puhuhu... Then it just means that all your
friendship talk was a lie, right?
Sh-Shut up! That's not possible!

Puhuhu... You're upset and irrational. At times
like this, a voice of reason is necessary.
Absolutely necessary!
G-Got it! We're up!

Alright, we're gonna put on a reasonable yet
outstanding show and earn our right to live!

Eh? Our right to live...? Is someone about
to die? Is that what's going on?

Whatever! I don't believe you!
There's no way the mastermind's here!

Wait... Even if it's one of the 16 students, it
doesn't mean it's one of us, does it?
Huh? What do you mean?

It's possible that the mastermind merely faked
their death, and has been alive this whole time.

Now that we know Monokuma will break rules
as he sees fit, that possibility should be—

What's that supposed to mean?
Hurry up and answer!

If you don't hurry up, I'm gonna blow up
the rest of the Monokubs!
Ahhh! Hurry up and answer!

<CLT=cltMIND>The identity of the mastermind...
We'll know for sure...

<CLT=cltMIND>once we determine
who killed Rantaro.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to confirm something
to find out who that is.
All of the causes of death

If we pin down all of the causes of death
for everyone who has died so far...

There are too many victims to determine if
one of them could've been the mastermind...

But we know for certain that the mastermind
was involved in Rantaro's death, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Alibis for Rantaro's murder
What happened after we first woke up

Let's try to remember exactly what
happened after we all woke up.

Hmm... I'm usually pretty good at
remembering, but that was a while ago...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Hey! Hurry up and answer!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>What I need to determine to
uncover the mastermind is...

We need to go over everyone's <CLT=cltSTRONG>alibi<CLT=cltNORMAL>
for Rantaro's murder again.
Our alibis...from way back then?

Didn't we discuss that during the first trial?
What good would it do to discuss it again?

Now that we know Rantaro was killed by the
mastermind, it might lead somewhere.

We might find a hole in someone's alibi that
we didn't see at the time.
...So we just have to give our alibis again.
F-Fine... Then let's do it.

So we can be sure that the mastermind's
not one of us...

Puhuhu... I wonder where this discussion
will lead.

Will it lead to a mastermind in this
very room? Or...not?

Either way, we're gonna make sure this
trial stays exciting!
